sheets.title: ELECTRICAL LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS, GENERAL CONSTRUCTION NOTES, SIGNS
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet for all electrical work. Legend defines symbols for new vs. existing devices. General notes: contractor must verify all equipment locations/sizes; all conduit ≥1/2" EMT unless noted; all power conductors #12 AWG minimum. Project identified as 'OVERHEAD CRANE SUPPORT BUILDING #3, NANSEMOND PRE-CAST CONCRETE CO., 3737 NANSEMOND PKWY, SUFFOLK VA 23435.' BFA job no. MAC-22-0001. Date: JAN. 26, 2023. SHT 1 OF 16. Engineer of record: TAM Consultants / Bowman Foster & Associates, signed and sealed.

sheets.title: SPECIFICATIONS — PART 1 GENERAL, PART 2 PRODUCTS (interior distribution, conduit, wiring, devices)
sheets.reading_notes: Two-page specification embedded in drawing set. Covers general requirements, wiring (all copper, #10 AWG minimum stranded), EMT conduit, flexible conduit, outlet boxes, device plates, switches, disconnect switches, fuses. Mandates UL-listed products, 2-year warranty, color-coded conductors (208/120V: A=black/B=red/C=blue; 480/277V: A=brown/B=orange/C=yellow). SHT 2 OF 16.

sheets.title: SPECIFICATIONS — PART 2 PRODUCTS (lighting), PART 3 EXECUTION
sheets.reading_notes: Continuation of specifications. Interior lighting requirements: LED driver and dimming switch compatibility required, energy efficiency submittals required, occupancy sensors (NEMA WD 1, UL 20, single pole). Execution: NFPA 70 compliance, conduit in concrete encased. SHT 3 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL LIGHTING PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 1-7, rows B.5–C)
sheets.reading_notes: Partial lighting plan for upper-right bay area of building. LED industrial high-bay fixtures typical throughout. Occupancy sensors. Exit signs and emergency battery units. Branch circuit panels 2-40 and 2-38 labeled. Control room shown in upper section. Keyplan shows this is the NE quadrant of the building footprint. SHT 4 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL LIGHTING PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 7-13, rows B–C)
sheets.reading_notes: Continuation of lighting plan, center-right bay area. Control room shown at column 12/row C. Branch circuit 5-11 feeds control room lighting. Occupancy sensors typical, exit signs, emergency units. SHT 5 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL LIGHTING PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 1-7, rows A–B)
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting plan lower-left bay quadrant. Branch circuits 2-36, 2-34, 2-32, 2-39 labeled. LED high-bays, occupancy sensors, exit signs, emergency units. SHT 6 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL LIGHTING PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 7-13, rows A–B)
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting plan lower-right bay quadrant. Completes the 4-quadrant lighting plan coverage of the full building. SHT 7 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL POWER PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 1-7, rows B.5–C)
sheets.reading_notes: Power plan upper-left quadrant. ePAK machine, PipePlus, mixer, batch plant, cement silo power connections. Branch circuits labeled N-16, N-14, N-15, N-18, etc. 3-phase 480V equipment feeders. Construction notes reference Hawkeye drawing 100369482A Issue A and additional drawing 100375736 Issue A as source for power/internet requirements. High-speed internet conduit from control room. SHT 8 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL POWER PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 7-13, rows B–C)
sheets.reading_notes: Power plan upper-right quadrant. Smart Set machine, WM-3450 device, Telekin #1/#2/#3, control room power. COL overhead door with motor operator. Construction notes reference BFA feeder schedule sheets E-601/L-601. SHT 9 OF 16.

sheets.title: PARTIAL POWER PLAN — NEW WORK (Bay columns 1-7, rows A–B)
sheets.reading_notes: Power plan lower-left quadrant. 15-ton and 20-ton overhead crane power feeders (3-phase 400A conductors visible). Butt welder unit, DTE Wiredraw machine, MBK machine, 50kW L-ion battery charger, compressors. Note 10 references using location of exterior electrical equipment from sheet E-601 to locate panelboards 'N', '1', '2', '3'; 30 kVA dry-type transformer. SHT 10 OF 16.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: 22-015 as BFA project number; MAC-22-0001 as drawing tracking number
conflict_flags.rationale: 22-015 matches the load letter project reference convention (consistent with other BFA projects using YY-NNN format). MAC-22-0001 appears to be the drawing/contract number used by TAM Consultants for this project. Both are valid references to the same project.
